need.role: Stationary humanoid target that the player punches to score hits.
need.constraints: Static, non-moving mannequin/dummy on a fixed base, roughly human-height (5-6 studs tall), CanCollide true, no built-in scripts required, visually reads as a punchable target (heavy bag or mannequin style), no moving parts or animation rig needed.

intent.experienceRole: Serves as the sole gameplay objective: the object the player must repeatedly strike to generate hit events and drive the on-screen counter.
intent.interaction: Non-interactive itself (it does not move or react physically); player-driven punch detection (touch/proximity/raycast) against this model triggers the hit sound, animation feedback, and counter increment on each successful punch.
reusableFeatures: Existing collision geometry suitable for touch/hit detection
Any built-in stand/base part to anchor the dummy in place
